lifecycle.verify_cmd: bash -lc "source /opt/ros/foxy/setup.bash && ros2 pkg prefix moveit >/dev/null && ros2 pkg prefix moveit_resources_panda_moveit_config >/dev/null"
lifecycle.start_cmd: bash -lc "source /opt/ros/foxy/setup.bash; ros2 launch moveit_resources_panda_moveit_config demo.launch.py rviz_tutorial:=True > /tmp/moveit2_nan_crash_target.log 2>&1"
lifecycle.stop_cmd: pkill -f "moveit_resources_panda_moveit_config demo.launch.py" || true; pkill -f "move_group" || true; pkill -f "rviz2" || true
